dct_title_s: St. Croix County, Wisconsin Tourist Camp
dct_description_sm: Stillwater has owned Kolliner Park, location of the St. Croix County, Wisconsin, Tourist Camp since 1917, when the East Side Lumber Company donated the property to the city. The company transferred the property to the city with the intent of preserving the property's natural beauty and restricting it from commercial development. The property is located directly across the St. Croix River from downtown Stillwater.
